source: 浪漫主义具有很强的文化决定论色彩。这源于歌德、费希特和施莱格尔等作家。
reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
hypothesis: Romanticism has a strong cultural-determinist character. This stems from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.

source: 合金基本上由两种或以上金属混合而成。不要忘记一点，元素周期表上有很多元素。
reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
hypothesis: Alloys are basically made by mixing two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.

source: 智利首选登山目的地科茶莫山谷 (Cochamó Valley) 被称为南美洲的优胜美地 (Yosemite)，这里有各式各样的花岗岩大石壁和峭壁。
reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
hypothesis: Cochamó Valley in Chile, a premier climbing destination, is known as the Yosemite of South America. It features a variety of granite big walls and crags.

source: 搅动两种干粉使其混合，然后用干净的湿手把它们揉成一个球。
reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
hypothesis: Stir the two kinds of dry powder together to mix them, then use clean, wet hands to knead them into a ball.

source: 小心不要让衣服变得太热（这可能会产生收缩现象，在极端情况下会把衣服烤焦）。
reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
hypothesis: Be careful not to let the clothes get too hot (this may cause shrinkage and, in extreme cases, scorch them).

source: 在独立战争期间，十三个州最初根据《联邦条例》组成了弱小的中央政府（国会是其唯一的组成部分）。
reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
hypothesis: During the Revolutionary War, thirteen states initially formed a weak central government under the Articles of Confederation (with Congress as its sole component).

source: 在某些地区，水煮一分钟就足够了，在其他地区则需要几分钟的时间。
reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
hypothesis: In some areas, boiling for one minute is enough, while in others, it takes several minutes.

source: 除去表示您的“Sie”之外的所有名词都应以大写字母开头，即使在句子中间也应如此。
reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
hypothesis: All nouns except “Sie” referring to you should begin with a capital letter, even when they appear in the middle of a sentence.

source: 与所有南非国家公园一样，该公园每天都收取养护费和门票费。
reference: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
hypothesis: Like all South African national parks, the park charges a daily conservation fee and an admission fee.

source: 如今，唯一不能向后折叠翅膀的昆虫是蜻蜓和蜉蝣。
reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
hypothesis: Today, the only insects that cannot fold their wings backward are dragonflies and mayflies.

source: 老虎是全能运动员，它会攀爬（虽然攀爬能力不是很强）、游泳、跳远，拉力能达到人类大力士的五倍。
reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
hypothesis: The tiger is an all-around athlete: it can climb (though its climbing ability isn’t very strong), swim, and jump long distances, and its pulling power can reach five times that of a strongman.

source: 实验是一种用来消除一个或多个可能性假设的试验，不过，实验并不是唯一的方法。提出问题及进行观察也可以指导科学研究。
reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
hypothesis: An experiment is a test used to eliminate one or more possible hypotheses, but it is not the only method. Asking questions and making observations can also guide scientific research.

source: 虽然没有人能确定作者是谁，但这个大型羊皮纸文档（尺寸为 29¾ 英寸乘以 24½ 英寸）据称在刚写成的时候是卷起来存放的。
reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
hypothesis: Although no one can be certain who the author was, this large parchment document, measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches, is said to have been stored rolled up when it was first written.

source: 还是有许多男女在这里幸存了下来，他们如今仍然健在；而更多人的亲人，有的在那里被屠杀，有的一直做苦工到死，犹太人和非犹太人都是如此。
reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
hypothesis: Still, many men and women survived here, and they are still alive today; meanwhile, more people had relatives there who were either murdered or forced to work as laborers until they died, both Jews and non-Jews alike.

source: 由于分离和重组，变异在每一代的两个库之间来回变动。
reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
hypothesis: Due to segregation and recombination, alleles fluctuate back and forth between the two gene pools of each generation.

source: 从传统意义上讲，海军的任务是确保国家保持运输人员和货物的能力，同时，干扰敌人运输其人员和货物的能力。
reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
hypothesis: In traditional terms, the navy's mission is to ensure that the nation maintains the capacity to transport personnel and goods while disrupting the enemy's ability to transport its personnel and goods.

source: 欧洲是片面积相对较小但有着许多独立国家的大陆。在通常情况下，穿越多个国家旅行意味着必须多次经历签证申请和护照检查。
reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent with many independent countries. Ordinarily, traveling through multiple countries means having to go through multiple visa applications and passport checks.

source: 但在队长输掉三柱门后，印度在结束这一局的比赛时只得了 36 分，输掉 7 个三柱门。
reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
hypothesis: But after the captain lost his three wickets, India scored only 36 runs at the end of the innings and lost the match by 7 wickets.

source: 孩子们因为各种原因被寄养，原因有被忽视、被虐待，甚至是被勒索。
reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
hypothesis: The children are fostered for various reasons: some because they were neglected, some because they were abused, and even some because they were being extorted.

source: 该大学的研究人员表示，这两种化合物相互作用形成的晶体可能会造成肾脏功能障碍。
reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
hypothesis: Researchers at the university said that crystals formed by the interaction of these two compounds may cause kidney dysfunction.

source: 他一直无法用药物来缓解疼痛，因为比赛禁止参赛者服用这些药物。
reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
hypothesis: He has been unable to relieve the pain with medication because the rules prohibit competitors from taking these drugs.

source: 阴暗面下面的地壳薄一些，高地下的地壳厚一些。
reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
hypothesis: The crust is thinner beneath the lowlands and thicker beneath the highlands.

source: 山羊似乎是 1 万年前左右在伊朗的扎格罗斯山脉首次被驯养的。
reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
hypothesis: Goats seem to have been first domesticated around 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

source: 仅仅两个星期，美国和自由法国的军队就解放了法国南部，并转向德国。
reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
hypothesis: In just two weeks, the armies of the United States and Free France liberated southern France and turned toward Germany.

source: 昨天，马尔泰利在由 9 名成员组成的新临时选举委员会 (CEP)中宣誓就职。
reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
hypothesis: Yesterday, Maltelli was sworn in as a member of the new provisional electoral commission (CEP), which consists of nine members.

source: 1940 年 8 月 15 日，盟军攻入法国南部，这次进攻被称为“龙骑兵行动”。
reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, the Allies entered southern France in an offensive known as Operation Dragonfly.

source: 更传统的教堂常常在复活节周末的周六晚上举行复活节守夜活动，会众通常在午夜钟声敲响之时涌入庆典，庆祝基督的复活。
reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
hypothesis: More traditional churches often hold Easter Vigil services on Saturday evening of Easter weekend, with congregants typically flooding into the celebration as the midnight bells ring, commemorating Christ’s resurrection.

source: 胡纳已经辞职，他在内阁中的位置将由国会议员埃德·戴维 (Ed Davey) 接替。预计国会议员诺曼·兰姆 (Norman Lamb) 将接替戴维空出的商务部长一职。
reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
hypothesis: Hoon has resigned, and his position in the cabinet will be taken over by MP Ed Davey. MP Norman Lamb is expected to take over the vacant post of Secretary of State for Business left by Davey.

source: 上周，日本经济产业省 (METI) 宣布，苹果公司向该部门通报另外 34 起过热造成的事故，尽管该公司称这些事故“并不严重”。
reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
hypothesis: Last week, Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) announced that Apple had reported 34 additional incidents of overheating to the ministry, although the company said the incidents were "not serious."

source: 这些理论研究为什么某些人想要做他们所做的事情，以及他们所处的环境中哪些事情会让他们做或不做某些事情。
reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
hypothesis: These theories study why certain people want to do the things they do, as well as what in their environment makes them do or not do certain things.

source: 自 1966 年以来，孙德尔本斯一直是野生动物保护区。据估计，目前该区生活着 400 只皇家孟加拉虎和大约 3 万只梅花鹿。
reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
hypothesis: Sundarbans has been a wildlife sanctuary since 1966. It is estimated that around 400 Royal Bengal tigers and roughly 30,000 sika deer currently inhabit the area.

source: 尽管戈马还算安全，但前往戈马以外的任何地方都应该事先调查，以便了解北基伍省持续的战斗有没有缓和。
reference: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
hypothesis: Although Goma is relatively safe, you should investigate beforehand before traveling anywhere other than Goma to find out whether the ongoing fighting in North Kivu Province has eased.

source: 地铁里的定期广播只有加泰罗尼亚语，但自动系统会用多种语言进行临时广播，包括西班牙语、英语、法语、阿拉伯语和日语。
reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
hypothesis: The regular announcements in the subway are only in Catalan, but the automated system makes occasional announcements in multiple languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

source: 水下的地形造成回流集中于几处较深的区域，那里可能会形成流向深水的急流。
reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
hypothesis: The underwater terrain causes the backflow to concentrate in several deeper areas, where strong currents flowing toward deeper water may form.

source: 对于哪些加工物品是古董，没有统一的定义。一些税务机构将 100 年以上的物品定义为古董。
reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
hypothesis: There is no uniform definition of which processed items qualify as antiques. Some tax authorities define items over 100 years old as antiques.

source: 现年 53 岁的库莫（Cuomo）从今年年初开始担任州长，并于上个月签署了一项将同性婚姻合法化的法案。
reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, has served as governor since the beginning of this year and signed a law legalizing same-sex marriage last month.

source: 它作为奢侈品中心的声誉始于公元 400 年左右，一直延续到公元 1100 年左右。
reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
hypothesis: Its reputation as a center of luxury began around AD 400 and continued until around AD 1100.

source: 早先于全球发布的华硕 Eee PC 个人笔记本，因成本节约及功能性因素，成为 2007 年台北 IT 资讯月备受瞩目的话题。
reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
hypothesis: The ASUS Eee PC personal notebook, launched worldwide earlier, became a highly talked-about topic at the 2007 Taipei IT Information Month due to its cost-saving features and functionality.

source: 卷心菜汁的颜色将根据化学物质的酸碱性发生变化。
reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
hypothesis: The color of the cabbage juice will change depending on the acidity or alkalinity of the chemical substance.

source: 例如，北卡罗莱纳州本尼特学校 ( Bennet School) 的学生每年都会设计一个有关他们的州府之行的网站。网站每年都会重新设计，但是老版本会在线保存，用作剪贴簿。
reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
hypothesis: For example, students at Bennett School in North Carolina design a website about their annual trip to the state capital every year. The website is redesigned each year, but the old versions are kept online as a scrapbook.
